label: I2C

local_timing_schema.label: evidence scope
local_timing_schema.description: Actual controller port, target port or complete transaction; legacy omitted scope remains transaction only.

local_timing_schema.label: master node id
local_timing_schema.description: Actual owning controller canonical identity. Not a target address.

local_timing_schema.label: slave address
local_timing_schema.description: Actual unshifted target integer or decimal/0x hexadecimal text, not the controller own port address.

local_timing_schema.label: i2c mode
local_timing_schema.description: Standard-mode is a review proposal from UM10204, not confirmed device configuration.

local_timing_schema.label: start stop bound us
local_timing_schema.description: Actual sum of START/repeatedSTART/STOP/bus-free timing for the transfer layout; no universal2us.

local_timing_schema.label: clock stretch limit us
local_timing_schema.description: Actual total target/controller stretch bound. I2C has no universal timeout; UFm requires zero.

local_timing_schema.label: transfer bits bound
local_timing_schema.description: Actual total data-phase clock bound including all address/data9th pulses/register overhead; HS entry separately bounded.

local_timing_schema.label: multi master
local_timing_schema.description: Actual competing controllers; not assumed false.

local_timing_schema.label: arbitration bound us
local_timing_schema.description: Actual complete retry/competition upper bound only for multicontroller transactions; no automatic zero.

local_timing_schema.label: bitrate bps
local_timing_schema.description: Actual data-phase bus clock, positive during active transfers; stopped0Hz is not a positive capacity rate.

local_timing_schema.label: hs entry rate bps
local_timing_schema.description: Actual HS entry F/S clock1..400k; optional outsideHS.

local_timing_schema.label: hs entry bound us
local_timing_schema.description: Actual HS entry duration incl9-bit controller-code/NACK phase; not serialized at HS rate.

local_timing_schema.label: bus cap pf
local_timing_schema.description: Actual HS line load needed for HS timing qualification, unknown.

local_timing_schema.label: hs clock timing source
local_timing_schema.description: Actual load-interpolated HS LOW/HIGH/edge timing and current-source proof.

local_timing_schema.label: address purpose
local_timing_schema.description: Actual reserved7-bit service purpose; absent legacy nonreserved target remains ordinary only.

bitrate_bps.label: I²C Bus Clock
bitrate_bps.description: Controller mode and confirmed bus clock are required; no unreviewed rate is assumed.

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual encoded data octets; I2C imposes no255-byte transfer maximum. Address/register/ninth-clock/layout overhead is separate.

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

i2c_profile.label: profile
i2c_profile.description: Actual electrical qualification. Section7.2 higher load requires its own proven timing/drive/segmentation and frequency bound.

i2c_mode.label: mode
i2c_mode.description: Operating mode. STANDARD100kbit/s is a proposed baseline, not minimum clock frequency. UFm is a different unidirectional push-pull system.

i2c_endpoint_role.label: endpoint role
i2c_endpoint_role.description: Actual endpoint role. A pure controller needs no own target address; controller-target does.

i2c_controller_id.label: controller id
i2c_controller_id.description: Actual canonical clock-owning controller identity. No invented ECU identity or topology owner confirmation.

i2c_device_source.label: device source
i2c_device_source.description: Actual controller/target datasheet revision, supported modes, pins and address constraints.

i2c_binding_source.label: binding source
i2c_binding_source.description: Actual matching controller-target port and segment binding, with unique addresses/multiplexing evidence.

i2c_physical_source.label: physical source
i2c_physical_source.description: Actual voltage/pull-up/driver/load/edge/threshold/segment evidence; nominal rate is not electrical validation.

i2c_schedule_source.label: schedule source
i2c_schedule_source.description: Actual transactions, register/address phases, polling/retry/stretch/arbitration and functional acceptance evidence.

i2c_drive.label: drive
i2c_drive.description: Actual driver. Sm/Fm/Fm+ wired-AND open drain/collector; HS controller current source; UFm push-pull.

i2c_address_bits.label: address bits
i2c_address_bits.description: Actual7/10-bit target address width, no inferred7-bit hardware configuration.

i2c_target_address.label: target address
i2c_target_address.description: Actual unshifted target address, excluding R/W. Reserved7-bit purposes require explicit matching service evidence.

i2c_address_purpose.label: address purpose
i2c_address_purpose.description: Actual ordinary versus reserved service addressing; general call/START/HS code/prefix are not interchangeable targets.

i2c_address_source.label: address source
i2c_address_source.description: Actual device straps/register/assigned address and reserved service meaning; unknown, no automatic0x20.

i2c_direction.label: direction
i2c_direction.description: Actual transaction direction. UFm accepts writes only; bidirectional requires combined address phases.

i2c_multi_controller.label: multi controller
i2c_multi_controller.description: Actual competing controller configuration. Arbitration is unnecessary for a proven single controller, not assumed false.

i2c_clock_stretch_supported.label: clock stretch supported
i2c_clock_stretch_supported.description: Actual matched controller/target stretching support. UFm cannot stretch; HS stretches only after ACK.

i2c_hs_entry_rate_bps.label: hs entry rate bps
i2c_hs_entry_rate_bps.description: Actual F/S-mode HS controller-code entry clock. HS3.4M data rate cannot size this preceding phase.

i2c_hs_controller_code.label: hs controller code
i2c_hs_controller_code.description: Actual reserved8-bit HS controller code00001XXX; code8 reserved test/diagnostic, not a target address.

i2c_hs_diagnostic.label: hs diagnostic
i2c_hs_diagnostic.description: Actual test/diagnostic use permitting controller code8; no implicit operational use.

i2c_stretch_position.label: stretch position
i2c_stretch_position.description: Actual stretch placement: HS only after ACK, UFm none. Stretch upper bound is device/schedule data, not a spec default.

i2c_ack_policy.label: ack policy
i2c_ack_policy.description: Bidirectional ACK/NACK is not CRC or functional acceptance. UFm preserves ninth pulse HIGH without target acknowledgement.

i2c_vdd_v.label: vdd v
i2c_vdd_v.description: Actual pull-up/driver supply domain; no universal3.3/5V.

i2c_vil_max_v.label: vil max v
i2c_vil_max_v.description: Actual receiver LOW threshold, including legacy fixed-level parts and level translators.

i2c_vih_min_v.label: vih min v
i2c_vih_min_v.description: Actual receiver HIGH threshold, not universally inferred from current CMOS ratios.

i2c_vol_max_v.label: vol max v
i2c_vol_max_v.description: Actual worst-case driver LOW at actual current/voltage/temperature.

i2c_voh_min_v.label: voh min v
i2c_voh_min_v.description: Actual UFm push-pull HIGH guarantee; passive open drain HIGH is pull-up/leakage/load evidence.

i2c_sink_bound_ma.label: sink bound ma
i2c_sink_bound_ma.description: Actual safe sink capability at specified VOL, not automatically3mA/20mA.

i2c_source_bound_ma.label: source bound ma
i2c_source_bound_ma.description: Actual UFm source capability or HS current-source qualification; not passive pull-up current.

i2c_pullup_ohms.label: pullup ohms
i2c_pullup_ohms.description: Actual passive pull-up for Sm/Fm/Fm+; Rp minimum depends on sink and VOL, maximum on rise time and capacitance. No4.7k default.

i2c_bus_cap_pf.label: bus cap pf
i2c_bus_cap_pf.description: Actual per-line wire+pins+connectors capacitance. Table11 limits400/400/550pF, HS100..400 interpolated timing; UFm no generic capacitance maximum.

i2c_pin_cap_pf.label: pin cap pf
i2c_pin_cap_pf.description: Actual pin capacitance. Ordinary qualified device max10pF; switches/multiplexers can exceed with explicit device evidence.

i2c_special_pin.label: special pin
i2c_special_pin.description: Actual special switch/multiplexer exception, unknown; prevents falsely applying ordinary10pF limit.

i2c_extended_frequency_bound_bps.label: extended frequency bound bps
i2c_extended_frequency_bound_bps.description: Actual verified section7.2 load/drive/RC/segmentation frequency bound, never an automatic higher mode or unspecified relaxation.

i2c_extended_source.label: extended source
i2c_extended_source.description: Actual section7.2 calculations/datasheet/buffer and rise/fall/voltage evidence for non-baseline electrical load.

i2c_bus_clear.label: bus clear
i2c_bus_clear.description: Actual recovery policy. Nine clocks are for SDA-stuck; SCL-stuck may require reset/power-cycle, not automatic nine-clock repair.

i2c_recovery_source.label: recovery source
i2c_recovery_source.description: Actual stuck-line/retry/recovery/acceptance limits and controller capability; recovery is extra schedule time.

i2c_retry_limit.label: retry limit
i2c_retry_limit.description: Actual transaction retry budget, no universal zero or guaranteed arbitration completion.

i2c_low_ns.label: low ns
i2c_low_ns.description: Actual low timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_high_ns.label: high ns
i2c_high_ns.description: Actual high timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_start_hold_ns.label: start hold ns
i2c_start_hold_ns.description: Actual start_hold timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_start_setup_ns.label: start setup ns
i2c_start_setup_ns.description: Actual start_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_stop_setup_ns.label: stop setup ns
i2c_stop_setup_ns.description: Actual stop_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_bus_free_ns.label: bus free ns
i2c_bus_free_ns.description: Actual bus_free timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_data_setup_ns.label: data setup ns
i2c_data_setup_ns.description: Actual data_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_data_hold_ns.label: data hold ns
i2c_data_hold_ns.description: Actual data_hold timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_rise_ns.label: rise ns
i2c_rise_ns.description: Actual rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_fall_ns.label: fall ns
i2c_fall_ns.description: Actual fall timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_data_valid_ns.label: data valid ns
i2c_data_valid_ns.description: Actual data_valid timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_ack_valid_ns.label: ack valid ns
i2c_ack_valid_ns.description: Actual ack_valid timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_hs_first_rise_ns.label: hs first rise ns
i2c_hs_first_rise_ns.description: Actual hs_first_rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_hs_data_rise_ns.label: hs data rise ns
i2c_hs_data_rise_ns.description: Actual hs_data_rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

i2c_hs_data_fall_ns.label: hs data fall ns
i2c_hs_data_fall_ns.description: Actual hs_data_fall timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.

parameter_proposals.note: Mode, controller, target, clock stretching and physical bus must be confirmed.

known_limitations: Technology-specific conformance details require a vendor/profile extension.
